::: {.tool-list}
### Human Agency Map
Records what people and machines currently produce and decide, who owns the consequential judgments and which capabilities need continued practice.

### Judgment Rubric
Defines criteria for a particular work product or decision, the evidence each criterion requires and the uncertainty the team can accept.

### Agentic Workflow Blueprint
Connects inputs, tasks, decisions, information, machine actions, human interventions, hand-offs, escalation and feedback. It adapts the logic of a service blueprint to human-machine agency.

### Decision Rights Map
Names who may recommend, execute, approve, override and escalate — and who remains accountable for the consequences.
:::

These are **intended workshop outputs**, made and revised with participants. They are not finished downloadable products or claims of a validated toolkit.
